C0964.title: Machine Learning-Driven Attacks Against Anti-Phishing Blacklists
C0964.summary: The study Machine Learning-Enabled Attacks on Anti-Phishing Blacklists, indexed in December 2024, analyzes machine-learning-assisted evasion of anti-phishing blacklists. It notes that blacklist defenses suffer from incomplete coverage and update delays, and that attackers can combine feature manipulation, IP rotation, and proxy use to increase the likelihood that phishing sites evade blacklist inclusion.
